body.purpose: The exact selected three-paragraph excerpt, left-aligned and vertically centered as one reading block.

picture-texture.purpose: The same 520 visible Newsreader glyphs arranged as a spare, edge-led lunch still life.

motion.name: scrub-travel
motion.purpose: Makes the direct reversible Day 001 scrub feel long and unhurried.

motion.name: tap-transition
motion.purpose: Carries a tap-triggered endpoint change at the artwork's slow, contemplative pace.

motion.name: scrub-settle
motion.purpose: Settles a released scrub softly at the selected endpoint without spring behavior.

motion.name: glyph-propagation
motion.value: passage-bounds lower-right to upper-left; smoothstep; very low seeded jitter
motion.purpose: Loosens ink diagonally from the actual text block while keeping per-glyph motion ordered and deterministic.

motion.name: glyph-flight-depth
motion.value: 48 base z + up to 155 movement z; 0.055rad max rotation; 24% max fade
motion.purpose: Adds restrained physical separation only while glyphs travel between flat endpoints.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Honors reduced-motion preference while preserving the complete interaction and both states.

components.name: Novel Passage Surface
components.description: The chrome-free reading endpoint: the exact selected three-paragraph excerpt, vertically centered while its lines remain conventionally left-aligned.
components.html:
I was in the middle of preparing lunch when the phone rang again. I had cut two slices of bread, spread them with butter and mustard…

I let the phone ring three times and cut the sandwich in half…

Still the phone went on ringing. Maybe fifteen times…
components.css: .ds-novel-page { display: flex; align-items: center; width: 320px; min-height: 568px; margin: 0; padding: 48px 29px; background: #f7f4ec; color: #1c1a17; font-family: Newsreader, Georgia, serif; font-size: 14.4px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.55; } .ds-reading-block { width: 100%; text-align: left; } .ds-novel-page p { margin: 0 0 0.8em; text-indent: 3ch; } .ds-novel-page:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1c1a17; outline-offset: -4px; }

components.name: Glyph Lunch Still Life
components.description: A spare, all-glyph illustration: one rectangular sandwich visibly separated into two diagonal halves with paper-filled interiors and two round tomato curves in the cut seam on a tightened-left plate with one outer contour and no inner rim, plus a broad, detached, outline-led, steam-free coffee cup.
components.css: .ds-lunch { position: relative; width: 360px; height: 270px; margin: 0; overflow: hidden; background: #f7f4ec; color: #1c1a17; font-family: Newsreader, Georgia, serif; font-size: 13.2px; line-height: 0.9; } .ds-plate, .ds-sandwich, .ds-half, .ds-tomato, .ds-cup, .ds-handle { position: absolute; overflow: hidden; } .ds-plate { left: 12px; bottom: 34px; width: 218px; height: 88px; border: 2px dotted #1c1a17; border-radius: 50%; padding: 16px; } .ds-sandwich { left: 36px; bottom: 76px; width: 174px; height: 102px; } .ds-half { inset: 0; padding: 8px; background: #f7f4ec; border: 2px dotted #1c1a17; font-weight: 600; } .ds-half-a { clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 100%); transform: translateY(-4px); } .ds-half-b { clip-path: polygon(0 0, 0 100%, 100% 100%); transform: translateY(4px); } .ds-tomato { z-index: 2; width: 34px; height: 19px; border-top: 2px dotted #1c1a17; border-radius: 50%; background: #f7f4ec; font-size: 9px; text-align: center; } .ds-tomato-a { left: 62px; top: 30px; transform: rotate(31deg); } .ds-tomato-b { left: 96px; top: 58px; transform: rotate(31deg); } .ds-cup { right: 23px; top: 82px; width: 70px; height: 68px; background: #f7f4ec; } .ds-rim { position: absolute; inset: 0 0 auto; padding-bottom: 3px; border-bottom: 2px dotted #1c1a17; text-align: center; } .ds-wall { position: absolute; top: 15px; bottom: 0; } .ds-wall-left { left: 1px; } .ds-wall-right { right: 1px; } .ds-handle { right: 7px; top: 99px; width: 20px; height: 34px; border-right: 2px dotted #1c1a17; border-radius: 0 18px 18px 0; text-align: right; } .ds-lunch:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1c1a17; outline-offset: -4px; }

narrative.overview:
Day 001 — Lunch is a quiet literary object before it is an interface. A warm paper field and a single serif voice make the opening state feel like a page from a well-kept paperback: intimate, patient, and unadorned. The selected first three paragraphs form a calm block centered vertically in the viewport while retaining conventional left-aligned reading. The app contributes no visible chrome, instruction label, panel, or decorative frame. The passage itself is the whole surface.

The signature move is literal and material: 520 visible glyphs leave their readable lines and assemble the lunch named in the prose. The final field is deliberately spare: one rectangular sandwich is visibly split into two diagonal halves with a narrow open seam and two round tomato curves, while a broad, detached coffee cup at the upper right uses an outline-led construction to clarify its rim, body, handle, and coffee without any steam.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper and near-black ink only
Newsreader as both readable prose and image-making material
A vertically centered, conventionally left-aligned three-paragraph reading block
Deterministic glyph placement at both endpoints
A rectangular sandwich silhouette with a clear diagonal cut and sparse tomato curves
A broad, detached, steam-free upper-right coffee cup
Continuous responsive fitting rather than device-specific layouts

rules.name: The Ink-on-Paper Rule
rules.body: Keep the artwork to one paper field and one ink color; form comes from density, overlap, scale, and motion rather than added color.

rules.name: The Every Mark Is Language Rule
rules.body: Do not replace, mask over, or supplement the glyphs with a visible illustration; every visible mark at the final endpoint must still be a passage character.

rules.name: The Selected Excerpt Rule
rules.body: Preserve the first three supplied paragraphs, including punctuation and paragraph breaks, with the requested correction from `knite` to `knife`; omit the later dialogue to protect the final field's clarity.

rules.name: The Continuous Fit Rule
rules.body: Recompute page layout and image targets from the current width and height; never hard-code a single phone's coordinates or crop the passage to protect a preferred font size.

rules.name: The Flat Endpoints Rule
rules.body: Reading and illustration endpoints must be optically flat; perspective, rotation, and fading exist only in flight.

rules.name: The Detached Cup Rule
rules.body: Keep clear warm-paper space between the plate and the upper-right coffee cup; the cup never sits on, touches, or visually merges with the plate.

rules.name: The Paper-Filled Cup Rule
rules.body: Build the cup from a sparse glyph outline around intentional paper-filled negative space; do not pack its interior into a solid text column.

rules.name: The Cut-Sandwich Rule
rules.body: Preserve a rectangular outer silhouette, open a narrow diagonal seam between the two halves, keep the bread interiors light, and use only two generous tomato curves in the seam.

rules.name: The Ink-Loosening Rule
rules.body: Motion begins at the passage's lower-right bound and travels diagonally up-left with restrained depth and almost no jitter; it must feel slow, gentle, and free of bounce.

dos: Do preserve the selected first three paragraphs with the requested `knife` correction as the source of all 520 visible glyphs.
Do center the reading block vertically while keeping every line conventionally left-aligned.
Do keep the page readable at one endpoint and the lunch immediately recognizable at the other.
Do use edge-led sampling and paper-filled interiors to keep both sandwich halves light.
Do keep the cup broad, outline-led, paper-filled, detached, and completely steam-free.
Do tighten the plate to the left so warm paper clearly separates it from the cup.
Do map vertical movement directly and reversibly to morph progress.
Do anchor propagation to the passage bounds' lower-right corner and carry it diagonally upward and left.
Do keep automatic motion slow, cubic, smoothstep-based, and bounce-free, with only very low deterministic jitter.
Do derive placement deterministically and recompute fitting for the current viewport.
Do provide reduced-motion behavior and adjustable accessibility actions with meaningful state labels.
donts: Don't add visible app chrome, gesture instructions, floating buttons, cards, or ornamental frames to Day 001.
Don't render the target mask or introduce non-glyph illustration marks.
Don't restore the later dialogue; its extra density weakens the distilled final image.
Don't horizontally center the passage or center its individual lines.
Don't merge the cup with the plate, fill either sandwich or cup into a dense mass, or omit the cup's rim, body, handle, or coffee.
Don't add steam or any glyph flourish above the cup.
Don't add accent colors, shadows, gradients, or decorative typefaces that weaken the quiet ink-on-paper world.
Don't launch the wave from the viewport corner, add spring bounce, or exaggerate depth, rotation, fading, or randomness.
Don't randomize final glyph placement between runs or crop passage content on smaller screens.
